plants.morphology: Fresh green fleshy round to broadly oval paired leaves along upright branching stems. A natural loose stem clump.
A low creeping carpet patch of tiny rounded bright green leaves on fine branching runners, naturally uneven low cushion.
A natural upright stem clump, narrow elongated copper-red to salmon leaves with green lower foliage. Open branching habit.
A rooted water sprite with delicate finely divided fresh green fronds and a soft airy fern outline. Ordinary submerged foliage.
A natural loose low moss tuft with fine irregular branching green strands and minute moss foliage, an airy irregular cushion, no stone or wood.
A natural clump of upright slender stems with distinctive bright green fan-shaped finely divided submerged foliage, delicate open fans.
A natural submerged stem bunch with dark green forked needle-like foliage in whorls, a bushy bottlebrush silhouette. Rootless stems gathered at the base, no invented root bundle.
A low spreading patch on creeping runners, fresh green small three-lobed clover-like leaves on slender petioles. Normal gently extended foliage.
A natural slender stem clump with small narrow elongated submerged leaves, green lower growth transitioning to warm pink-orange shoot tips. Delicate branching silhouette.
A natural branching stem clump with broad oval pointed leaves, rich burgundy and ruby red upper foliage and olive green lower foliage. Ordinary flat leaves.

solids.shape: A single ochre-brown aquarium dragon stone, deeply eroded irregular grooves and pitted ridges, rugged upright asymmetric form, broad stable base.
A dark reddish black porous volcanic lava rock, rounded irregular squat form, rough large natural pores in painted texture.
A naturally fractured low broad slate outcrop, thin horizontal blue-grey sedimentary shelves stepping down asymmetrically, stable broad footprint, one coherent rock.
A chunky milky white aquarium quartz rock with broad angular translucent-looking mineral faces and warm grey veins, irregular blunt facets, no long crystal spikes.
A pale tan aquarium spiderwood root, graceful arching fine branching root limbs connected to a compact central knot, natural blunt weathered tips, stable root feet.
A dense gnarled low mopani driftwood, contrasting honey tan smooth worn face and very dark brown underside, compact twisting solid trunk with short stout root feet.
A dark russet mangrove root with a raised central trunk supported by natural arching stilt roots, visible open spaces beneath roots, broad stable footprint, weathered blunt ends.

A short weathered hollow bamboo section lying horizontally, olive golden bamboo skin and a distinct raised bamboo node near the back, large open circular front entrance and visible dark inner wall, stable flat underside.
A small aquarium shelter assembled from flat dark grey slate, a low slab roof resting on natural stone side walls, clearly open broad low front entrance and deep inner chamber, no door.

A small aquarium ornament of an old mossy grey stone castle tower, squat round masonry tower with a broken crenellated top, a large arched swim-through doorway at the base, restrained worn stone carving, no flags or scenery.

plant_art_policy: A natural clump of the species, ordinary gently extended foliage. No prescribed leaf count, arrangement, spread/bend angle, curled, hooked, flipped-up or unfolding showcase leaf.

research.evidence: Official game list includes Bacopa rotundifolia, Hemianthus callitrichoides and Ammannia gracilis. Avoid duplicating existing sword/crypt/vallisneria forms.
Fish Game developer announcement adds Ceratopteris thalictroides (Water Sprite).
Aquarium producer lists Hydrocotyle tripartita and Taxiphyllum barbieri.
Aquarium producer lists fan-stem Cabomba and Ceratophyllum demersum.
Aquarium producer layout uses Ludwigia repens Rubin and Rotala rotundifolia.

research_scope: Game lists establish examples, not frequency statistics across all games. Additional species selected from real aquarium planting references for distinct silhouettes. No third-party game art is copied.
